audience: HR and finance teams that look up employees, job positions and departments in Lucca

useCases.title: Find employees by legal entity
useCases.text: List the legal entities, then list the employees of one entity, filtered by status or department.

useCases.title: Check job positions and employments
useCases.text: List job positions with their department, site, manager and dates, and read the employments behind them.

useCases.title: Review the department structure
useCases.text: List the departments with their parent, level and manager, and open one department by id.

useCases.title: Create or rename a department
useCases.text: Create a department with a description, or change the name or description of one department.

useCases.title: Check sites and custom taxonomy values
useCases.text: List the business establishments with their address and timezone, and the values of custom taxonomies.
